name: smwblocks-carryable-sprite-spawner-blocks-pack
title: Carryable Sprite Spawner Blocks Pack
description:
This is a pack containing 10 custom blocks that can spawn every carryable vanilla sprite in Mario's hands if the player is holding a run button. It works with:

- Baby Yoshi
- Buzzy Beetle
- Bob-Omb
- Galoomba
- Key
- Mechakoopa
- P-Switch
- Shell
- Spring
- Throwblock

Make sure to check out the ASM files for some customization options. Also remember that the mechakoopa, beetle and bomb sprites need tileset specific graphics.

V1.1:
- Fixed an issue with the position of the spawned sprite
